October 18, 2026


– The


trailer and new images from


YOU, ME, US


, the new film directed by


Daniele Luchetti


and starring


Elio Germano and Maria Chiara Giannetta


, are now available. The film premieres today at the


Rome Film Fest


, Out of Competition in the


Grand Public


section.


Noi, un po’ meglio


is a Netflix film produced by


Lucky Red


, directed by


Daniele Luchetti


and written by


Enrico Audenino, Davide Lantieri and Serena Patrignanelli


, with the collaboration of Luchetti. The cast includes


Elio Germano and Maria Chiara Giannetta


, alongside


Anna Bonaiuto, Ilaria Spada, Caterina Guzzanti, Dajana Roncione, Jacopo Olmo Antinori, Francesca Romana De Martini and Filippo Nigro


.


SYNOPSIS:


Simone (Elio Germano) and Lucia (Maria Chiara Giannetta) could not be more different: he is a methodical man who loves rules and family celebrations, while she is independent, allergic to conventions and has always been opposed to motherhood. Despite their differences, their relationship is very strong, and every disagreement eventually gives way to love, complicity and a constant struggle... until something changes. When the challenge becomes adopting a child, this new adventure brings their deepest differences to the surface. Will they be able to overcome the many obstacles this journey puts in their path? A sentimental comedy that highlights the need to confront our own fears and desires in an attempt to become ourselves… a little better.
